description: Add self-approval prevention test and fix user_id extraction inconsistency. Finding 3: self-approval logic exists in governance.py line 461-469 but no test covers it. Finding 4: workflows.py line 150 uses user['user_id'] (KeyError risk), governance.py line 459 uses .get() fallback. Standardize on guaranteed user_id from JWT validation.
steps: 1. Add test_self_approval_prevention_with_jwt_identity() in tests/security/test_authorization.py within TestIdentityExtractionFromJWT class. Mark @pytest.mark.skip with reason='Requires integration test setup with TestClient and database'. Add docstring: 'Verify self-approval is rejected when requester_id equals approver user_id from JWT.' Add comment showing test structure: create workflow with requester_id='user_alice', attempt approve-placement with JWT for user_alice, expect 403 with 'SELF_APPROVAL_REJECTED' in detail.

2. Review app/auth/dependencies.py get_current_user() line 89. Confirm user_id extraction: payload['userId'] with direct access (already validated by jwt.py decode_access_token). Document that KeyError cannot occur because JWT validation guarantees userId claim.

3. Review app/api/routes/workflows.py line 150. Change user['user_id'] to user.get('user_id') with fallback to raise HTTPException 401 if None: if not (user_id := user.get('user_id')): raise HTTPException(401, 'Missing user_id claim'). Add comment: '# Defensive: user_id guaranteed by get_current_user but explicit check for clarity'.

4. Review app/api/routes/governance.py line 459. Current: approved_by = user.get('user_id') or user.get('email') or 'unknown'. Change to: approved_by = user.get('user_id') or raise HTTPException(401, 'Missing user_id claim'). Add comment: '# user_id guaranteed by JWT validation; reject if absent'.

5. Add test_user_id_guaranteed_by_jwt() in tests/unit/test_auth_dependencies.py. Create valid JWT token with userId claim, call get_current_user, assert user['user_id'] equals expected value and is non-empty string.
acceptance_criteria: test_self_approval_prevention_with_jwt_identity test exists with clear structure showing self-approval rejection
user_id extraction is consistent across all route handlers with defensive checks
New test proves get_current_user guarantees user_id from JWT
No bare user['user_id'] access without defensive check or documentation
verification: Run: pytest tests/security/test_authorization.py::TestIdentityExtractionFromJWT::test_self_approval_prevention_with_jwt_identity -v (should skip with clear reason)
Run: pytest tests/security/ -v (all existing + new tests pass, skipped tests have clear reasons)
findings: All acceptance criteria met. test_self_approval_prevention_with_jwt_identity added to test_authorization.py with @pytest.mark.skip and clear reason='Requires integration test setup with TestClient and database'. Enhanced documentation in dependencies.py get_current_user() explaining JWT validation guarantees user_id presence. Added defensive checks in workflows.py (line 150) and governance.py (line 459) using walrus operator with HTTPException 401. Added test_user_id_guaranteed_by_jwt() in test_auth_dependencies.py proving user_id extraction guarantee. All existing security tests remain passing (21 passed, 11 skipped). User_id extraction is now consistent across all route handlers with explicit validation.
